messages:
Jared: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands finance section, post runway/procurement questions here.
Maya: Headline: runway ~18 months on plan; we have targeted levers if bookings slip.
Sophie: can you share a one-line breakdown of monthly burn?
Maya: Monthly ~ $3.2M — payroll ~$1.4M, infra/GPU ~$1.25M, GTM ~$350k, other ~$200k (rounded).
Ben: Trigger for broad hiring freeze?
Jared: Board notification if runway <12 months. Before that, selective freezes + VP+Finance signoff for new reqs.
Sophie: procurement thresholds? renewals surprised teams last cycle.
ProcurementBot: New policy: purchases > $5k require Finance review; > $25k require Legal + CFO signoff. Auto-hold renewals > $15k. Submit via https://redwood.internal/procure and tag "expedite" for customer-impacting buys.
Maya: Managers can approve up to $1k; Directors + Finance for $1k-$5k. Anything above needs Finance signoff.
Sophie: SLA for approvals?
ProcurementBot: Targets: <$5k: 2 business days; $5k-$25k: 5 business days; >$25k: 10 business days. Expedited triage for true customer-impact items (~24hrs).
Ben: Capex for GPUs — threshold?
Jared: Any capex > $200k goes through ROI review and board notice. Small purchases evaluated case-by-case.
Sophie: who to contact for exceptions?
Maya: Open a procurement ticket, tag @Jared and @Maya, include customer-impact justification and rollback plan. We'll triage within 24hrs for real customer-impacting cases.
Jared: We'll post the updated approval matrix + short FAQ to #finance-docs. Thanks everyone.
